description: This file defines the TiffWriter class, which manages TIFF IFDs and tags for writing TIFF/DNG headers, including methods for adding entries, building entries, managing IFDs, and calculating header size.

classes.name: TiffWriter
classes.description: Manages TIFF IFDs and tags for writing TIFF/DNG headers, supporting entry addition, header size calculation, and header writing.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the TIFF header with all IFDs and tags to the output.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a TIFF entry to a specified IFD.

methods.name: buildEntry
methods.description: Constructs a TIFF entry for a known tag with validation.

methods.name: addStrip
methods.description: Sets strip-related tags for a given IFD.

methods.name: getEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific TIFF entry by tag and IFD.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes a specific TIFF entry by tag and IFD.

methods.name: addIfd
methods.description: Creates and adds an empty IFD with a given ID.

methods.name: addSubIfd
methods.description: Creates and adds a sub-IFD under a parent IFD.

methods.name: getDefaultType
methods.description: Returns default type for a given tag.

methods.name: getDefaultCount
methods.description: Returns default count for a given tag.

methods.name: hasIfd
methods.description: Checks if an IFD with a specific ID exists.

methods.name: checkIfDefined
methods.description: Checks if a tag is defined.

methods.name: getTagName
methods.description: Returns the name of a tag if defined.

methods.name: uncheckedBuildEntry
methods.description: Builds a TIFF entry without validation.

methods.name: buildTagMap
methods.description: Creates a mapping from tag definitions.
